user.title: Aigües Barcelona History
user.description: Submit credentials to sign in through 2Captcha, which incurs one CAPTCHA charge. Alternatively, provide an existing token to validate it without a new login.

token.title: Aigües Barcelona History: validate existing token
token.description: The token is checked through a read-only contracts request. This does not create a new session or purchase a CAPTCHA.

reauth_confirm.title: Aigües Barcelona History: sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Opening this form does not sign in. Submit without a token to use the saved credentials and pay for one CAPTCHA, or provide an existing token to validate it without a new login. The existing account and configured contracts are preserved.

import_settings.title: History import settings
import_settings.description: Choose how much hourly consumption and daily reference history to request. Aigües may return less data than requested. Existing saved history is kept.

data.energy_daily_fallback: Use daily totals when hours are incomplete

data_description.hourly_history_days: Number of past days to request, plus today. Used by the hourly import button and the one-time import. Available hourly history may be shorter.
data_description.history_days: Number of past days to request for daily history, plus today. These totals remain separate from reported hours and provide older Energy history.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Recent consumption refreshes automatically at this interval. The configured histories can be requested separately with their import buttons.
data_description.should_import_history: Run both configured imports once after setup. This switches off after a successful import. Use the import buttons whenever you need to request data again.
data_description.energy_daily_fallback: For past days with incomplete hours, Energy can temporarily show one aggregate bar from the daily total. Today always uses reported hours. Disable this to keep partial recent hours while waiting for remaining readings. Older history remains daily.

init.title: History and refresh settings
init.description: Set the range used by each import button and the automatic refresh interval. Changing a range does not delete saved data. Enable the one-time import to request both histories after saving.

data.energy_daily_fallback: Use daily totals when hours are incomplete

data_description.hourly_history_days: Number of past days to request, plus today. Used by the hourly import button and the one-time import. Available hourly history may be shorter.
data_description.history_days: Number of past days to request for daily history, plus today. These totals remain separate from reported hours and provide older Energy history.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Recent consumption refreshes automatically at this interval. The configured histories can be requested separately with their import buttons.
data_description.should_import_history: Run both configured imports once after saving. This switches off after a successful import. Completed imports do not repeat on every restart. You can use the import buttons later.
data_description.energy_daily_fallback: For past days with incomplete hours, Energy can temporarily show one aggregate bar from the daily total. Today always uses reported hours. Disable this to keep partial recent hours while waiting for remaining readings. Older history remains daily.
